flags.message: Companion petition: the provisioned petition (footnote 1) says the Institute for Justice filed Pena v. City of Los Angeles (CA9) concurrently, and one amicus filename in this docket carries No. 25-1163. That petition is public pre-snapshot information and shaped the summary-disposition-route claim (a hold-and-GVR path if Pena alone is granted). I could not find 25-1163 on CourtListener, so its docket state is unverified.
